description: Answer whether the person is coming: "yes", "no", or "clear" to remove the answer. For a repeating event the answer is for one occurrence: the next one by default, or pass occurrence_date (see get_plan event.upcoming). Only with the user's confirmation.

occurrence_date.description: Repeating events only: the date of the occurrence to answer for.

plan.description: Plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id.
